g.text: Projection from measured medians, not an observed 10-task run · one learning pass · frozen navigation skill = 1,480 tokens

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52616e

g.text: Raw(N) = N × raw. Minimap(N) = first use + (N − 1) × reuse + skill loads × 1,480. Break-even includes the first use.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52616e

g.text: Each text is counted once per load. Model context replay, caching, reasoning, exploration and repairs are unmeasured; these are not billing curves.
